title.en: A dry ultrasound interface clears three different tests
title.zh: 干式超声接口通过三种不同考验

summary.en: MIT’s November 19 report describes a liquid-free ultrasound coupling material. Nine-day phantom imaging, a ten-minute sweat test and a thirty-minute cycling demonstration establish different results, with clinical use still prospective.
summary.zh: MIT于11月19日介绍无液体超声耦合材料。九天模型成像、十分钟汗液测试与三十分钟骑行展示各有证据范围，临床用途仍待推进。

title.en: The EU–UK youth promise has several different clocks
title.zh: 欧英青年交流承诺，走在几只不同的时钟上

summary.en: The November 20 summit sets out a Youth Experience Scheme for 100,000 young people in each direction, with separate 2028 and January 2030 aims. Erasmus 2027 and prospective tuition-fee negotiations follow distinct paths.
summary.zh: 11月20日峰会提出双方各10万人的青年体验计划，2028年与2030年1月目标各指不同阶段；2027年Erasmus及学费谈判另循各自路径。
